title: Mirror Counts of Spectral Curves
summary: Given a convex lattice polygon $Δ\subset \mathbb R^2$, let $N_Δ$ be the count of rational, nodal curves in the linear system of the ample line bundle $L_Δ$ on the toric variety $\mathbb P_Δ$ defined by $Δ$, having fixed intersection with the toric boundary. We show that the relative Jacobian of the linear system defines an integrable system that has a mirror dual in the language of constructible sheaves on a two-torus microsupported on a Legendrian link.
